integrity: The interval is proved analytically after symmetrization by exact pair- and triple-collision moment constraints. Endpoint joint laws are explicitly constructed by uniformization within occupancy types. Exact-rational enumeration is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes over four abstract three-wise-independent uniform random variables, not a fixed implementable hash family.
For five or more keys the analogous occupancy-moment polytope is higher-dimensional and is not classified here.
The closest pairwise-occupancy repository result could not be opened beyond its indexed statement summary during this review.
title: Exact four-key birthday envelope under three-wise-independent hashing
